  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Line 4 of the changelog lists when the guard does not fire as "unreadable state" or "status other than `pass`". It leaves out a third case: a `pass` result with nonzero `rpg_pre_repair_failures`, which the guard in scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:839-841 also rejects (`[ "${rpg_pre_repair_failures}" = 0 ]`).
  WHY: There is no runtime failure, only documentation drift. A reader of CHANGELOG.md would expect the guard to fire on any readable `pass` result with an empty post-repair tree. The headline sentence at line 2 ("passed with no PR-caused failure") is accurate. The source rated this NIT, mapped here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this finding and did not report it: line 2 already states the full firing condition, and a well-formed result cannot be `pass` with a nonzero failure count.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
